nodes.label: Intents-first language report
nodes.rationale: Secondary research and design proposal using the working name IKL; this does not rename Moriarty or independently verify its opaque citations.

nodes.label: Intent
nodes.rationale: Signed financial meaning combines outcomes with bounded authority; it is separate from permission, plan, execution and receipt.

nodes.label: Permission
nodes.rationale: A desired outcome does not authorize every route capable of achieving it.

nodes.label: Concrete solver plan
nodes.rationale: A solver-selected strategy must satisfy the signed authority, safety and goal constraints.

nodes.label: Backend execution
nodes.rationale: Execution is the realized backend behavior, distinct from the plan and evidence about it.

nodes.label: Execution or lifecycle receipt
nodes.rationale: Evidence records established status and state anchors; a pending source operation must not be mislabeled settled.

nodes.label: Hard outcome goal
nodes.rationale: An acceptable outcome is a hard condition, not a ranking preference.

nodes.label: Phase-indexed safety requirement
nodes.rationale: Safety may apply to every observable prefix rather than only terminal state.

nodes.label: Bounded authority
nodes.rationale: Bounds cover amount, asset, owner, recipients and effects; goal satisfaction cannot enlarge them.

nodes.label: Declared environmental assumption
nodes.rationale: Facts not established locally require named evidence and explicit trust boundaries.

nodes.label: Solver preference
nodes.rationale: Ranks already valid plans; it cannot permit a safety or authority violation.

nodes.label: Resource commitment or lock
nodes.rationale: Stateful reservation prevents concurrent reuse while external work is pending.

nodes.label: Persistent financial obligation
nodes.rationale: An asynchronous claim must remain represented until fulfillment, refund, cancellation or failure disposition.

nodes.label: Observable execution trace
nodes.rationale: Final balances alone can hide an unauthorized intermediate debit or unsafe temporary state.

nodes.label: Plan acceptance judgment
nodes.rationale: Requires signature, freshness, types, bounded effects, prefix safety, lifecycle, evidence and goal status.

nodes.label: Compiler and adapter trace refinement
nodes.rationale: Generated backend traces must be a subset of source-authorized traces; unsupported semantics may reject but cannot weaken.

nodes.label: Feasibility and anti-vacuity
nodes.rationale: An always-reject compiler satisfies subset inclusion vacuously and must not count as successful compilation.

nodes.label: Typed settlement adapter
nodes.rationale: Adapter specifications constrain authority, observable effects, code identity and semantic version.

nodes.label: Bounded deterministic verification
nodes.rationale: No unbounded loops, recursion, quantification or unconstrained callbacks; verification expressiveness differs from search capability. Report Nat/Int sketches still require concrete finite Moriarty widths.

nodes.label: Untrusted solver search
nodes.rationale: Solvers may search for plans or decline unsupported fragments; they cannot reinterpret signed hard constraints.

nodes.label: Canonical outcome Intent IR
nodes.rationale: Canonical financial authorization is hashed independently from solver plan selection.

nodes.label: Solver Plan IR
nodes.rationale: Steps, domains, adapter identities, dependencies, capabilities, revert policies and expected effects remain downstream of intent.

nodes.label: Solver Query
nodes.rationale: References the intent and carries preferences and disclosure policy without mutating signed semantics.

nodes.label: Canonical semantic encoding
nodes.rationale: The semantic hash covers version, subject, validity, replay, identities, authority, requirements, assumptions and lifecycle.

nodes.label: Signed semantic authorization
nodes.rationale: The solver must not mutate the signed intent; authentication alone does not supply financial meaning.

nodes.label: Deterministic wallet rendering
nodes.rationale: Render from the signed semantic object; unsupported semantic extensions cause signing refusal.

nodes.label: Authority-domain replay protection
nodes.rationale: Replay semantics and authority domain belong to signed meaning; backend nonce layouts are versioned encodings.

nodes.label: Time and validity domain
nodes.rationale: Deadlines and observation phases have explicit semantic meaning.

nodes.label: Adapter and semantic version binding
nodes.rationale: An unchanged ABI does not authorize an upgraded backend with weaker behavior.

nodes.label: Complete authority-consuming effects
nodes.rationale: Every mediated effect must lie within authority; declared summaries alone cannot excuse hidden callbacks.

nodes.label: Gross debit and prefix exposure
nodes.rationale: A round trip may restore net balance after exceeding authority; terminal net deltas cannot establish spend safety.

nodes.label: Net asset-delta accounting
nodes.rationale: Useful local settlement observable, but not a universal intent language or complete authority trace.

nodes.label: Residual capability budget
nodes.rationale: Each fill consumes authority and carries forward only the remaining budget.

nodes.label: Partial-fill lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Cumulative spending and each-fill conditions survive multiple solvers without duplicating signed authority.

nodes.label: Linearized authority home
nodes.rationale: A settlement domain must atomically consume or lock authority; static types alone cannot stop concurrent cross-domain double use.

nodes.label: Intent composition operators
nodes.rationale: Conjunction, alternatives, sequence, parallelism and bounded repetition have distinct laws and premises.

nodes.label: Resource separation and noninterference
nodes.rationale: Parallel frame guarantees require disjoint resources or a proved noninterference condition.

nodes.label: Alternative branch authority
nodes.rationale: The source must identify whether user, solver, protocol or environment chooses an alternative.

nodes.label: Bounded recurring authority
nodes.rationale: Finite periods, aggregate budget, next window and revocation state prevent duplicated period payments.

nodes.label: Asynchronous lifecycle state machine
nodes.rationale: Locked, executing, fulfilled, settled, refundable and recovery states express progress without inventing cross-domain atomicity.

nodes.label: Compensation versus rollback
nodes.rationale: A later refund is a new economic action, not reversal of an already finalized history.

nodes.label: Finality and recovery race policy
nodes.rationale: Destination inclusion is insufficient under a stronger finality policy; timeout does not prove late fulfillment impossible.

nodes.label: Domain and issuer-qualified asset
nodes.rationale: Identical tickers or address bytes on different domains do not establish asset equivalence.

nodes.label: Financial units and quantities
nodes.rationale: Use asset-native integer quantities and typed rates; reject incompatible unit arithmetic.

nodes.label: Explicit rounded arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Upward and downward mulDiv are separate semantic operations; no floating-point IR arithmetic.

nodes.label: Provenanced observation
nodes.rationale: Source, value, domain, anchor, time and finality identify the input and its applicability.

nodes.label: External economic truth boundary
nodes.rationale: Proof of computation over an attested input does not establish oracle, issuer, custodian or bridge truth.

nodes.label: Asset conservation
nodes.rationale: Asset-indexed net change equals explicit mint minus burn under complete observed accounting.

nodes.label: Economic solvency
nodes.rationale: Token conservation does not establish realizable assets sufficient for obligations.

nodes.label: Time-indexed liquidity
nodes.rationale: Available cash covering due payments differs from accounting conservation and solvency.

nodes.label: Explicit liabilities and claims
nodes.rationale: Refinance meaning includes extinguished and newly created debt; contingent claims are not settled assets.

nodes.label: Intent disclosure and privacy
nodes.rationale: Private solver transport does not prove privacy; goals, authority, preferences, timing and probes can leak.

nodes.label: Proof-carrying plans
nodes.rationale: Report binds plan, intent, adapter, state and effects but does not define recursively compliant predecessor histories. Its selective-ZK recommendation must not replace Moriarty mandatory PCD.

nodes.label: Distinct evidence classes
nodes.rationale: Authorization, plan refinement, execution, predicate, optimality and external attestation establish different claims.

nodes.label: Solver optimality boundary
nodes.rationale: Meeting a minimum output does not prove globally best available price.

nodes.label: NEAR Intents Verifier
nodes.rationale: Report describes atomic internal-balance matching with a separate asynchronous external-call boundary.

nodes.label: CAKE reference architecture
nodes.rationale: Application, Permissions, Solving and Settlement are system layers; its tradeoff framing is not a formal impossibility theorem.

nodes.label: ERC-7683 solver interface
nodes.rationale: Report treats the current draft as Plan IR precedent, not the user-signed source language; versions must be pinned.

nodes.label: ERC-7540 asynchronous vault
nodes.rationale: Pending/Claimable/Claimed lifecycle is a regression case; cancellation cannot be fabricated by a lowering.

nodes.label: EVM account and execution adapters
nodes.rationale: Signing, permission, account abstraction, delegation and batching supply backend facilities rather than intent semantics.

nodes.label: Extended UTxO portability
nodes.rationale: Consumes the old capability and creates a residual output; report proposes portability testing, not initial production priority.

nodes.label: UniswapX Reactor adapters
nodes.rationale: Order validation and fulfillment checking can remain separate from arbitrary filler routes.

nodes.label: Anoma resource semantics
nodes.rationale: Create/consume resources motivate affine accounting without inheriting unrestricted predicates.

nodes.label: Marlowe temporal financial semantics
nodes.rationale: Timeouts and explicit deterministic time motivate a lifecycle tier.

nodes.label: DeFiFormal coverage corpus
nodes.rationale: Mechanism taxonomy and counterexamples remain library coverage evidence, not primitive-kernel correctness.

nodes.label: Withdrawn four-primitive basis
nodes.rationale: Report cites the repository withdrawal of the Q/Sigma foundation; keyword classifications are not semantic certificates.

nodes.label: Source-to-backend compiler pipeline
nodes.rationale: Parsing and elaboration lead to canonical intent, signing, solving, adapter lowering and scoped evidence.

nodes.label: Typed financial source syntax
nodes.rationale: Authorize, require, assume, prefer and lifecycle describe semantics; financial names belong in libraries. IKL grammar is a report proposal, not selected Moriarty grammar.

nodes.label: Reported IKL checker prototype
nodes.rationale: Report claims two passing checker tests and links a sandbox ZIP; those artifacts/results are not reproduced by reading this file.

nodes.label: Adversarial conformance suite
nodes.rationale: Mutate debit, recipient, identity, rounding, lifecycle, obligations, evidence and callback behavior to test protected semantics.

nodes.label: Semantic extension governance
nodes.rationale: Unknown semantic extensions reject; optional advisory extensions may be ignored; adapters require refinement.

nodes.label: Unsafe foreign-call escape hatch
nodes.rationale: Report proposes explicit reapproval of unsafe calls; such calls do not belong inside Moriarty certified bounded acceptance without complete checked effects and bounds.

nodes.label: Held-out financial expressivity test
nodes.rationale: Challenge the kernel with nonlinear arithmetic, async claims and shared authority without smuggling semantics into arbitrary callbacks.

nodes.label: Versioned financial libraries
nodes.rationale: Swaps, loans, vaults, derivatives, settlement constructions and fee arithmetic should elaborate into shared semantics.

nodes.label: Delegated authority non-amplification
nodes.rationale: Agents and subagents may propose actions but cannot amplify a parent capability; LLM reasoning is outside trusted authorization.

nodes.label: Quote-first exact-plan profile
nodes.rationale: Exact deltas can be selected then signed; solver freedom ends at signing. This is a valid restricted profile, not equivalent to route-flexible outcome authorization.

nodes.label: Conditional settlement liveness
nodes.rationale: Eventual settlement needs chain progress, solver/liquidity availability and message-delivery assumptions.

nodes.label: Progress versus terminal fulfillment
nodes.rationale: A pending receipt carries live obligations; successful source-chain execution alone must not satisfy a terminal settlement claim.

Persistent authority and claims across asynchronous progress
